subject: Emergency all-hands
body:
2026-10-27T09:00:00+01:00 — Sandra Kowalski: The course files are missing. Kofi and I saw a pale figure. Let's separate observations from the names being passed around.
2026-10-27T09:01:05+01:00 — Priya Nair: The BK-02 dock is empty too. I'm checking recovery. Please preserve the current records rather than annotating over them.
2026-10-27T09:02:06+01:00 — Marcus Fenwick: I was home asleep by eleven. What do you mean gone? There is a lot of work in those modules.
2026-10-27T09:03:09+01:00 — Jule Hartmann: This is not what I meant when I objected to the title. Please don't turn copy complaints into declarations about missing files.
2026-10-27T09:04:14+01:00 — Kofi Mensah: We saw it through the glass and lost it at the stairs. I couldn't identify the person.
2026-10-27T09:05:20+01:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Programs will assemble a summary with teaching and IT input. Send original material so we can compare the accounts.
2026-10-27T09:06:26+01:00 — Ines Duarte: Keep the calculation with the registration figure. A refund question isn't a decision, however many times the number gets forwarded.
2026-10-27T09:07:28+01:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Students still have ordinary questions. Keep those in the normal queues while we collect the incident material. Ghost stories can wait.
